name: What is the typical timeline for a threshold or ramp adjustment project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a threshold or ramp adjustment project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for threshold or ramp adjustment projects depends on their scope and complexity. Simple threshold replacements can often be completed within a day. A small, prefabricated ramp might be installed in a day or two. Custom-built ramps, especially those requiring concrete work or significant structural modifications, can take several days to a week or more, including planning, material acquisition, construction, and finishing. We will provide an estimated timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple threshold work takes a day. Custom ramps or complex adjustments can take several days to over a week, depending on scope.
